title: MRTS runner-profile contract contradicted a user-approved local configuration
title_de: MRTS-Runner-Profilvertrag widersprach einer nutzergenehmigten lokalen Konfiguration
profile: MRTS shared local Codex runner profile
summary: The current user confirmed that the retained Framework-style MRTS configuration is the intended trusted local runner profile. The conflicting MRTS-only default-deny contract was a documentation/validator drift, not a product-security finding.
summary_de: Der aktuelle Nutzer bestätigte, dass die aufbewahrte Framework-artige MRTS-Konfiguration das beabsichtigte vertrauenswürdige lokale Runner-Profil ist. Der widersprüchliche MRTS-spezifische Default-Deny-Vertrag war eine Dokumentations-/Validator-Drift, kein Produkt-Sicherheitsbefund.
observed_behavior: The live MRTS configuration matches the retained user-approved snapshot SHA-256 ee2e0437e2c5c3b8926b96ff68b617197140bea2602a8b8e094d4c1686ec0cfb. It uses the same local runner-profile type as Parent and Framework: workspace-write, declared network access, exact support roots, inherit = all, secret exclusions, and a non-secret path map.
observed_behavior_de: Die Live-MRTS-Konfiguration entspricht dem aufbewahrten nutzergenehmigten Snapshot SHA-256 ee2e0437e2c5c3b8926b96ff68b617197140bea2602a8b8e094d4c1686ec0cfb. Sie verwendet denselben lokalen Runner-Profiltyp wie Parent und Framework: workspace-write, deklarierten Netzwerkzugriff, exakte Support-Wurzeln, inherit = all, Secret-Ausschlüsse und eine nicht geheime Pfadzuordnung.
expected_behavior: MRTS declares its exact user-approved shared runner profile in the structure manifest. The native validator must reject profile drift while allowing the declared network, roots, TMPDIR setting, inherit = all, and non-secret environment map. The declaration does not confer task authority or prove runtime enforcement.
expected_behavior_de: MRTS deklariert sein exaktes nutzergenehmigtes gemeinsames Runner-Profil im Strukturmanifest. Der native Validator muss Profilabweichungen ablehnen, aber den deklarierten Netzwerkzugriff, die Wurzeln, die TMPDIR-Einstellung, inherit = all und die nicht geheime Umgebungszuordnung zulassen. Die Deklaration verleiht keine Task-Autorität und beweist keine Runtime-Enforcement.
impact: No supported product security boundary is crossed: the ignored local file is trusted operator configuration and no less-privileged or remote writer was evidenced. The profile remains local declarative evidence only; runtime filesystem and network enforcement are not verified.
impact_de: Es wird keine unterstützte Produkt-Sicherheitsgrenze überschritten: Die ignorierte lokale Datei ist vertrauenswürdige Operator-Konfiguration und es wurde kein weniger privilegierter oder Remote-Writer nachgewiesen. Das Profil bleibt nur lokale deklarative Evidence; Runtime-Dateisystem- und Netzwerk-Enforcement sind nicht verifiziert.
preconditions: The current top-level user selects the MRTS shared local runner profile.
A Codex session resolves the trusted ignored MRTS project configuration.
reproduction: Compare the live config to the retained user-approved snapshot with SHA-256 `ee2e0437e2c5c3b8926b96ff68b617197140bea2602a8b8e094d4c1686ec0cfb`.
Run `rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/validate-governance.py` from the MRTS root; the manifest-driven validator exits 0.

Run `rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python .codex/bin/validate-codex-inheritance.py --check --all --json --explain` from the Parent root; it exits 0 with only documented legacy warnings.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python tools/validate-governance.py; rtk proxy /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python .codex/bin/validate-codex-inheritance.py --check --repository mrts --json --explain

rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python tools/validate-governance.py; rtk proxy /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python .codex/bin/validate-codex-inheritance.py --check --all --json --explain

root_cause: The local MRTS manifest and native validator incorrectly imposed a restrictive default-deny configuration despite the user-approved shared local runner profile already used by Parent and Framework. The ignored config has no tracked Git baseline, and no untrusted writer or runtime boundary was evidenced.
root_cause_de: Das lokale MRTS-Manifest und der native Validator erzwingten fälschlich eine restriktive Default-Deny-Konfiguration, obwohl das nutzergenehmigte gemeinsame lokale Runner-Profil bereits von Parent und Framework verwendet wird. Die ignorierte Config hat keinen getrackten Git-Baseline, und es wurde kein nicht vertrauenswürdiger Writer oder Runtime-Boundary nachgewiesen.
proposed_remediation: Completed: restore the retained user-approved profile and align the manifest, validator, tests, and directly contradictory documentation. Preserve explicit secret exclusions, no-MCP/plugin controls, task-authorization boundaries, and the no-runtime-enforcement claim.
proposed_remediation_de: Abgeschlossen: Das aufbewahrte nutzergenehmigte Profil wiederherstellen und Manifest, Validator, Tests sowie direkt widersprüchliche Dokumentation ausrichten. Explizite Secret-Ausschlüsse, No-MCP/Plugin-Kontrollen, Task-Autorisierungsgrenzen und die fehlende Runtime-Enforcement-Behauptung bleiben erhalten.
acceptance_criteria: MRTS `.codex/structure-manifest.toml` declares the exact network, roots, TMPDIR, inherit, secret-exclusion, and environment-map profile.
The native MRTS governance validator exits 0 and rejects profile drift.
The Parent MRTS-scoped and all-root inheritance validators exit 0 without violations.
The six focused MRTS governance tests and 133 Parent control-plane tests pass.
No Git, Gitlink, remote, dependency, generator, or delivery action is changed by this alignment.
validation_plan: Run the native MRTS governance validator and its focused unittest module with bytecode disabled.
Run the Parent MRTS-scoped and all-root inheritance validators with JSON explanation.
Run the Parent local control-plane test suite and review Git whitespace/status without Git writes.
legitimate_control_tests: tools/validate-governance.py reports the regular MRTS governance structure and policy markers as valid.
The Parent MRTS-scoped and all-root inheritance validators report a compliant configuration.
residual_risk: The user-approved runner profile declares network access and support roots for trusted local work. Configuration and validators are local governance evidence only; they do not prove runtime filesystem/network enforcement. Concurrent non-task Parent, Framework, MRTS, and ignored-control-plane changes still prevent a whole-workspace continuity claim.
residual_risk_de: Das nutzergenehmigte Runner-Profil deklariert Netzwerkzugriff und Support-Wurzeln für vertrauenswürdige lokale Arbeit. Konfiguration und Validatoren sind nur lokale Governance-Evidence; sie beweisen kein Runtime-Dateisystem-/Netzwerk-Enforcement. Parallele nicht task-eigene Parent-, Framework-, MRTS- und ignorierte Control-Plane-Änderungen verhindern weiterhin eine Whole-Workspace-Continuity-Aussage.

history.detail: The ignored MRTS config showed broad Framework-style roots, enabled network, full inherited environment, and injected environment values; static validators rejected the declared contract.
Only the violated config controls were restored. The original native validator, its five focused tests, and the Parent MRTS-scoped validator passed; no runtime enforcement claim was made.
The config was overwritten again during final regression. The native validator, focused current-tree test, and Parent all-root validator returned the original control violations.

The current user confirmed the retained Framework-style MRTS runner profile is intended. Static comparison found the same trusted local profile type in Parent and Framework and no less-privileged or remote writer/product boundary. The exact profile was restored; manifest-driven validation and focused tests passed; the finding is not applicable as a product-security issue.
